@metadata.comment: English UI messages. Banana format: https://github.com/wikimedia/banana-i18n

shell-welcome: A quiet place to write your novel.
settings-save-failed: Your settings couldn't be saved. They'll apply until you close Plot Device.
dialog-new-project-location: Choose where to create the project
dialog-backup-location: Choose where to keep the backup
welcome-bring-in-question: Already have notes or a draft?
new-project-hint: A template's outlines and kinds of pages are written in the book's language.
new-project-adjust-later: Everything can be changed later: the kinds of pages, the outlines, the names.
template-novel-description: Chapters, characters, places and notes, with a three-act outline.
template-short-story-description: One chapter, ready to write, and a short outline.
template-poetry-description: Poems instead of chapters, one ready to write, and an outline to put them in order.
template-poetry-outlines: Order of the collection: three sections
template-campaign-description: Sessions instead of chapters; NPCs, locations, factions, items and lore.
template-blank-description: Chapters, characters, places and notes, and nothing else.
open-failed-not-a-project: This folder isn't a Plot Device project. Choose a folder that has a project.md file.
open-failed-unreadable: This project couldn't be read. Nothing was changed.
open-failed-newer-format: This project was made with a newer version of Plot Device. Update Plot Device to open it.
open-failed-not-recent: That project is no longer in the recent list.
create-failed-folder-exists: There's already a folder with that name in this place. Choose another title or another place.
create-failed-inside-project: That place is inside another project's folder. Choose a place outside it.
create-failed: The project couldn't be created. Nothing was changed; try choosing another place.
write-empty-unit-text: Start writing; you can name it now or later.
navigator-no-chapters: This book has no chapters yet.
write-empty-text: A book is written one chapter at a time. Start the first; you can name it now or later.
prompt-poem-title: Poem title (you can leave it empty)
change-failed-stale: The book's contents were changed in another app at the same time, so your change wasn't made. They've been reloaded; please try again.
change-failed-name-taken: Another file already has that name. Choose a different one.
change-failed-invalid-name: That name can't be used for a file. Leave out characters such as / \ : * ? " < > |.
change-failed: That change couldn't be made. Nothing was changed.
chapter-unreadable: This can't be shown: the file isn't plain text, or the information at its top is damaged. Nothing in it will be changed.
chapter-missing: This file is missing from the book's folder. It may have been moved or deleted outside Plot Device.
save-failed: Couldn't save. Your text is kept here, and saving will try again as you type.
niqqud-hint: Choose a mark to add it, and again to take it off. The arrow keys go to the next letter.
niqqud-no-letter: Put the cursor just after a Hebrew letter, then open Niqqud again.
plain-text-banner: Plain text. Changes here are saved exactly as typed.
conflict-title: This was changed in another app
conflict-body: While you were writing, “$1” was changed outside Plot Device. Your latest text is safe here and hasn't been saved over the other version.
conflict-keep-both-detail: Your text is saved as a separate copy, and this one shows the other version.
conflict-use-mine-detail: Your text replaces the other version. The other changes will be lost.
conflict-kept: Your text was saved as “$1”, under On the side.
conflict-kept-beside: Your text was saved as “$1”, beside this one.
conflict-failed: That didn't work. Your text is still safe here; please try again.
story-empty-text: An outline is the plan of your story: sections are the big steps, cards are the moments in each step. You never need one to write.
gallery-empty-character-text: Each character has a page of their own: a name, other names, a short description, and how they relate to others.
gallery-empty-place-text: Each place has a page of its own: a name, a short description, and what happens there.
gallery-empty-note-text: Notes hold everything else about the world: history, rules, research, ideas.
gallery-empty-kind-text: Each page has a name, other names, a short description, tags, and how it relates to other pages.
kinds-hint: What your book keeps pages about. Renaming a kind changes only what Plot Device calls it; its folder stays as it is.
kinds-remove-confirm: Remove “$1” from the kinds of pages? {{PLURAL:$2|Its page stays|Its $2 pages stay}} in the book, under “Not sorted yet”. Nothing is deleted.
kinds-not-saved: This kind couldn't be saved. Fill in both names, and choose a folder name that isn't used yet and has no characters such as / or :.
kinds-unit-hint: Only Plot Device's words change; the files and the book's contents stay as they are. Leave both empty for “chapter”.
kinds-part-unit-hint: Only Plot Device's words change; the files and the book's contents stay as they are. Leave both empty for “part”.
kinds-mismatch: Some folder names no longer match what you call them in Plot Device. This only matters if you open the book's folder in other apps.
match-hint: Each folder gets its kind's name. Its pages move with it, and every link to them is updated.
match-links: {{PLURAL:$1|1 link|$1 links}} in {{PLURAL:$2|1 file|$2 files}} will be updated.
match-blocked-exists: A folder with this name already exists.
match-blocked-case-only: The names differ only in capital letters, which Plot Device can't change safely. You can rename this folder yourself in your computer's file manager.
match-blocked-invalid-name: This name can't be used for a folder. Rename the kind without characters such as / or :.
match-blocked-other-files: The folder has files that aren't pages, so it stays as it is.
match-blocked-missing: This folder can't be found. It may have been moved or deleted outside Plot Device.
match-backup-hint: Renaming changes many files at once. Keep a copy of the whole book first.
match-backup-failed: The backup couldn't be saved there. Try another folder.
match-nothing: None of these folders can be renamed right now.
folders-undone: The folder names are back as they were.
folders-undo-stale: Some files were changed after the rename, so the folders can't be renamed back without overwriting them. Nothing was changed.
folders-failed: The folders couldn't be renamed. Please try again.
story-manuscript-hint: The reading order, as the book has it. Chapters are arranged in Write.
outline-guide: Sections are the big steps of your story. Cards are the moments in each step. Add details under a card.
outline-text-hint: Type freely: Enter adds a card, Tab makes it a detail, and $2 makes a line a section. @ links a page. $1 goes back.
outline-text-kept: {{PLURAL:$1|One passage|$1 passages}} will show “kept as written” on the board.
item-link-hint: Type @ to link a character, place, note or chapter
outline-line-keys: Enter: next line · Tab: make it a detail · Shift+Tab: back out · Esc: done
line-keys-nest: Tab: make it a detail of “$1”
outline-empty: This outline is empty. Start with a section.
confirm-delete-item: Delete “$1”? Its details will be deleted too.
confirm-delete-section: Delete the section “$1” and everything in it?
kept-explanation: The Board and List can't show this, so it stays exactly as written. You can edit it in Text.
locked-item: This card shares its line with other formatting, so it can't be moved here. You can move it in Text.
invalid-details: This outline's name and settings, at the top of its file, couldn't be read. The outline still works, and that part is left as it is.
outline-changed-elsewhere: This outline was changed in another app, so your change wasn't made. It's been reloaded; please try again.
outline-undo-refused: This outline was changed in another app since your last change, so undoing would overwrite that. Nothing was undone.
outline-refused-unnamed-section: Cards above the first section can't be changed this way. Move them into a section first.
outline-refused-multiline-heading: This section's name is written over two lines in the file, so it can't be renamed here. Rename it in Text.
outline-failed: That change couldn't be made. Nothing was changed.
reference-hint: The first paragraph is the description; everything after it is details.
reference-failed: That page couldn't be changed. It's as it was.
prompt-relationship-words: How is $1 related to $2? For example: Sister of
relationship-changed-elsewhere: This page was changed in another app, so your change wasn't made. It's been reloaded; please try again.
tags-failed: The tags couldn't be changed. The page is as it was.
tags-unreadable: The information at the top of this page's file can't be read, so its tags can't be changed here. Nothing was changed.
prompt-tag-rename: New name for “$1”, on {{PLURAL:$2|one page|$2 pages}}. Use an existing tag's name to merge the two.
confirm-tag-remove: Remove the tag “$1” from {{PLURAL:$2|one page|$2 pages}}? The pages themselves stay.
tag-retagged-skipped: Changed on {{PLURAL:$1|one page|$1 pages}}. {{PLURAL:$2|One page|$2 pages}} couldn't be changed: $3.
tidy-duplicates: These look like the same tag
tidy-unreadable: Pages whose tags can't be read
linked-from-none: Nothing links here yet. On a card, “Link to…” adds a link.
arc-start-hint: A new outline for $1's story, linked to this page
shelf-search: Find a character, place or note
shelf-empty: Search, or pin a page to keep it here.
link-search: Find a chapter, character, place or note
versions-none: No earlier versions yet. They are kept as you write, at most every ten minutes.
versions-restore-detail: What you have now is kept as a version, so this can be undone.
versions-restored: The earlier version is back. What you had is kept as a version.
versions-stale: This was changed in another app after you opened its versions. Nothing was restored. Close this window and open it again to see the latest.
versions-failed: That didn't work. Nothing was changed.
import-add-menu: Add chapters from a Word file…
import-new-hint: Bring in a manuscript you already have (.docx).
import-new-chapters: {{PLURAL:$1|One chapter|$1 chapters}} from the Word file. Fill in the book's details below; the Word file itself won't change.
import-new-create: Make the book with {{PLURAL:$1|one chapter|$1 chapters}}
import-split-headings-hint: Word's heading styles start the chapters. Bigger headings above them become parts.
import-split-chapter-lines-hint: Lines like “Chapter 3” or “Chapter Three” start the chapters, and lines like “Part One” the parts.
import-split-page-breaks-hint: Each new page starts a chapter.
import-list-hint: Click a name to rename it. Untick a chapter to leave it out.
import-tracked-changes: Tracked changes are taken as accepted. The title page isn't brought in.
import-footnotes: {{PLURAL:$1|One footnote is|$1 footnotes are}} kept, at the end of {{PLURAL:$1|its chapter|their chapters}}.
import-part-name: The new part, at the end of the book
import-add: Add {{PLURAL:$1|one chapter|$1 chapters}} at the end
imported-chapters: Added {{PLURAL:$1|one chapter|$1 chapters}} at the end of the book.
imported-chapters-details: Added {{PLURAL:$1|one chapter|$1 chapters}} at the end of the book. The Word file is called “$2”, by $3.
import-failed-too-big: That Word file is too big to bring in (over 50 MB).
import-failed-not-a-word-file: That isn't a Word file Plot Device can read. Save it as a Word document (.docx) and try again.
import-failed-old-or-protected: That Word file is in the old .doc format, or protected with a password. Open it in Word, save it as a .docx without a password, and try again.
import-failed-unreadable: That Word file can't be read. It may be damaged.
import-failed-no-project: Open a book to add chapters to it.
import-failed-no-import: The Word file is no longer open. Choose it again.
import-failed-no-chapters: Choose at least one chapter to bring in.
import-failed-stale: The book changed while you were choosing. Nothing was added; try again.
import-failed-invalid: The chapters couldn't be added to the book's contents. Nothing was changed.
import-failed-write-failed: The chapters couldn't be saved. Nothing was lost; try again.
import-failed-unreadable-book: The book's contents can't be read, so nothing was added.
export-format-word-hint: For editors and publishers. They can edit it and mark changes. Opens in Word, Google Docs, LibreOffice and Pages.
export-format-pdf-hint: For reading on any device. Looks the same everywhere and can't be edited.
export-format-epub-hint: For e-book readers and e-book stores (an EPUB file).
export-format-markdown-hint: Plain text with formatting marks, for other writing tools.
export-no-title: This book doesn't have a title yet. The title you type here is saved with the book.
export-author-hint-page: Shown on the title page and at the top of each page.
export-author-hint-epub: Shown in the e-book's details and in stores.
export-author-hint-markdown: Written at the top of the file.
export-saves-details: The title and author you typed are saved with the book when you export.
export-none-chosen: Choose at least one chapter to export.
export-cover-missing: The cover picture “$1” can't be found. It may have been moved. Choose it again, or export without it.
export-unreadable: These chapters can't be read, so they'll be left out: $1.
exported-missing: Exported “$1”, without these chapters, which couldn't be read: $2.
export-failed-no-project: Open a book to export it.
export-failed-no-chapters: Choose at least one chapter to export.
export-failed-cover-unreadable: The cover picture can't be read. Choose another, or remove it.
export-failed-details-failed: The title couldn't be saved with the book, so nothing was exported. Try again.
export-failed-write-failed: The book couldn't be saved there. Nothing was changed; try another folder.
export-failed-export-failed: Something went wrong while making the file. Nothing was changed; try again.
about-license: Plot Device is open-source software: you may use, study, share and change it under the GNU General Public License, version 3 or later.
about-yours: Everything you write with Plot Device is yours, under your own copyright. The licence covers the program, never your writing.
update-failed: Couldn't check for updates. Check your internet connection, or try again later.
settings-check-updates-hint: Once a day, Plot Device asks GitHub whether a newer version is out. Nothing about you or your writing is sent.
settings-plain-text: Show plain text when I open a page
settings-plain-text-hint: Shows every formatting mark, such as # and *, for fixing things by hand. When this is off, pages show formatted text.
settings-plain-text-switch: Show the plain-text switch beside Format
settings-plain-text-switch-hint: For anyone who knows Markdown: one click, or $1, switches between formatted text and every mark.
about-coffee: Plot twist: this app runs on coffee. ☕ If Plot Device helps you write, you can $1. I'll put it toward the next chapter… of the code.
timeline-columns-from: Column names come from the main outline:
timeline-columns-hint: Click a name to rename it; + adds a section.
timeline-rename-column: A section of $1. Click to rename it.
main-swap-question: Make “$1” the main outline? The timeline’s columns will take the names of its sections. Nothing in your outlines changes: not the text, not the line-ups. You can switch back at any time.
timeline-hidden: {{PLURAL:$1|One storyline is hidden.|$1 storylines are hidden.}}
timeline-cant-line-up-missing: Can’t line up: “$1” isn’t there any more.
timeline-cant-line-up-order: Can’t line up with “$1”: it would put this storyline out of order.
timeline-one-text: Make an outline for a character, a place or the past, and line up a few of its moments with this one. Everything else falls in between.
timeline-drag-section: Drag onto a moment to line it up
outline-delete-lined-up: {{PLURAL:$1|One section of another outline is lined up with it; it will show “can’t line up”.|$1 sections of other outlines are lined up with it; they will show “can’t line up”.}}
outline-delete-for-good-question: Your computer has no Trash that Plot Device can use. Delete “$1” anyway? Plot Device keeps a backup, so you can undo this right after; once the book is closed, it can only come back from that backup.
outline-delete-failed: The outline couldn’t be deleted. Nothing was changed.
outline-delete-what: Only this outline is deleted, with its own sections and cards. Chapters, pages and other outlines stay as they are.
outline-delete-backup: It goes to your computer’s Trash, and Plot Device keeps a backup, so you can undo this right after.
outline-delete-suggest: Only want it out of the way? Set it aside instead: nothing is deleted, and you can bring it back any time.
timeline-cant-line-up-fix: Use ⋯ to line it up again or unpin it.
timeline-no-choices: No moment fits without changing this storyline’s order.
backups-what: Once a day, if you've changed anything, Plot Device saves a backup of this whole book into the folder you choose here, as one zip file named with the book's title, the date and the time.
backups-none: Backups are off for this book. Choose a folder to turn them on.
backups-sync-hint: To keep a copy off this computer, choose a folder that already syncs online, such as your Google Drive, Dropbox, OneDrive or Obsidian Sync folder. Plot Device doesn't upload anything itself.
backups-never-deleted: Plot Device never deletes these backups. They add up over time, so check the space in that folder now and then, or turn on a clean-up below.
backups-cleanup-hint: A clean-up removes only the daily backups Plot Device saved itself, never the newest one, and never one you saved with Back up now. You'll see a note whenever it removes any.
backups-on: Backups are on. The first one is in $1.
backups-removed: {{PLURAL:$1|One old backup|$1 old backups}} of “$2” {{PLURAL:$1|was|were}} removed, as your clean-up asks.
backup-problem-missing-folder: The backup folder can't be found, so no backup was saved. Is the drive connected? You can choose it again in Backups…, in the book menu.
backup-problem-no-space: The backup couldn't be saved: there's no space left in the backup folder. Your book is fine. Free up some space there, or choose another folder in Backups…, in the book menu.
backup-problem-inside-book: Backups can't be kept inside the book's own folder. Choose another folder in Backups…, in the book menu.
backup-problem-failed: The backup couldn't be saved. Your book is fine; nothing in it was changed.
backup-offer-title: Keep a copy of “$1” somewhere safe?
backup-offer-text: Plot Device can save a backup of this book once a day, into a folder you choose.
backup-offer-later: You can turn backups on or off at any time: Backups…, in the book menu.
restore-no-folder: This book has no backup folder yet. Choose one in Backups…, in the book menu.
restore-none: There are no backups of this book in its backup folder yet.
restore-same: This backup is the same as the book now.
restore-changed: {{PLURAL:$1|One file is|$1 files are}} different in the book now.
restore-returning: {{PLURAL:$1|One file|$1 files}} from the backup {{PLURAL:$1|is|are}} no longer in the book.
restore-newer: {{PLURAL:$1|One file was|$1 files were}} added since this backup. {{PLURAL:$1|It stays|They stay}} either way.
restore-replace-warning: This replaces what's in “$1” now with the backup from $2. Before it does, Plot Device saves a backup of the book as it is now, so you can go back to it from this same list. The backup you're restoring stays where it is too.
restore-failed: The backup couldn't be restored. Your book is as it was.
restored-as-copy: The backup is now a book of its own, beside this one: $1
restored-replaced: The book is back to the backup from $1. The book as it was is saved as a backup too.
sample-restart-confirm: Start the sample over? This erases everything in the sample book, including what you wrote and any pages and outlines you added or changed, and puts back the original sample. Your other books stay exactly as they are.
sample-restarted: The sample is back as it first was.
sample-restart-failed: The sample couldn't be started over. It's as you left it.
